leaks.line: Hey Bao, do you have a minute? I need to contest a missing package. The carrier says it was delivered, but it is not here. I plan to call their customer service line, give them the tracking number, and have them mark it as lost so a claim can be filed right away. What do you think of that approach?

The timeline varies, but many carriers aim for resolution within a few business days. Crows are also highly social birds that engage in cooperative breeding, where helpers assist in raising young, which mirrors the way customer service teams should collaborate to resolve your issue quickly. I am certain they will prioritize your request given your clear instructions.
